title: observability: refine KV token-level cost/latency dashboard and alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: token-level KV metrics and alert thresholds have been noisy since we increased burst capacity for Dedicated customers. This PR refines the KV cost/latency dashboard panels, tightens alert thresholds to reduce false positives, and adds early-warning traces for slow KV path latencies.

Changes: 1) Add new derived metrics for token-level KV cost and per-token p99 latency (normalized by seq_len). 2) Introduce a lightweight sampling-based trace tag for KV slow-path to reduce tracing volume. 3) Update alert rules: split high-cost alerts (cost-per-token) from high-latency KV alerts, add a cooldown window and a dynamic threshold based on rolling median. 4) Dashboard improvements: new heatmap for cost-by-model, improved time ranges and annotations for deploys. 5) Docs: add runbook section with triage steps and suggested mitigations.

Checklist:
- [x] Metrics: promql and exporters updated
- [x] Tracing: sampling + tag implemented
- [x] Alerts: rule files updated with cooldowns and dedupe windows
- [x] Dashboards: visual improvements and notes
- [x] Docs: runbook and release notes

Notes: kept changes minimal to avoid churn in consumers of the dashboard; new metrics are opt-in via config flag observability.kv_token_metrics_enabled. Related: ENG-4123, PM-88. CI flaky integration test required a rerun once (see CI checks).

d4e5f6a: add sampling tag for kv_slow_path traces and opt-in config flag
b7c8d9e: update alert rules: split cost vs latency, add cooldown and dynamic threshold
c9d0e1f: dashboard: add model heatmap and deploy annotations

review_comments: Evan Morris (reviewer): Left a few nits on promql readability and suggested using rate() for the cost counter aggregation. Also recommended adding an override knob for enterprise customers.
Aisha Patel (author): Addressed promql nits and added an enterprise config override 'observability.kv_cost_threshold_override'. Updated tests to cover the override behavior.
Diego Ramirez (reviewer): Asked for clarification on the tracing sampling rate and the expected cardinality impact. Suggested adding a short explainer in the doc runbook.
Aisha Patel (author): Added a section in docs/observability/kv-dashboard-runbook.md explaining sampling rationale and estimated trace volume. Lowered default sampling from 1% to 0.5% to reduce noise.
Priya Nair (reviewer): Verified alert cooldown and dedupe windows look sane for production; requested a short post-merge follow-up to monitor false-positive rate for 48 hours.
Evan Morris (approver): Approved after CI rerun passed. Left a note to monitor the heatmap for heavy models and consider adding a per-model cost cap next quarter.
release_notes: Refined KV token-level cost & latency observability: new derived metrics, sampling for KV slow-path traces, split alerts for cost vs latency with cooldowns, and dashboard enhancements (heatmap + deploy annotations). Added runbook for triage.
post_merge_actions: Monitor kv_cost_per_token and kv_token_p99 for 48h after deploy
Evaluate false-positive alert rate and adjust dynamic threshold multiplier if >5%
Follow up to consider per-model cost caps (quarterly roadmap)
